fusions.name: Silk Snare
fusions.desc: Spits a strand of silk that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Tangled Brood
fusions.desc: Spins a web out around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each ally within 5.5 tiles adds 10% damage, up to 30%. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Roost Web
fusions.desc: Spins a trap that waits 60 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 20 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Strand by Strand
fusions.desc: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the strands pull tight and strike it for 34% of your weapon damage per strand (170% at full). Unfed, a strand fades every 4 seconds.
